data.notes: February's confirmed music calendar in Tulum was centered on post-Zamna beach-club and jungle-side electronic programming at venues including Vagalume, Papaya Playa Project, Arena, Bonbonniere and Nômade.

events.title: this.place w. Sideral (Habitat, Afterlife)
events.summary: The fourth and closing this.place residency event at Vagalume featured Sideral, Pysh and Irena Stanisic. The bill leaned into deep, melodic and contemporary electronic sounds.

events.title: SHAVORÃ featuring Yawanawá Leaders, JPool, Xamonika, Maibe Beats, John Transcend with Chëlla
events.summary: Arena hosted a hybrid ceremonial music and electronic program with Yawanawá leaders, JPool, Xamonika, Maibe Beats and John Transcend with Chëlla. The published schedule included acoustic medicine music, a Yawanawá concert segment and a JPool hybrid DJ/live set.

events.title: Claptone & More Artists x Mixmag
events.summary: Mixmag's Vagalume date was headlined by Claptone with VITE, Aaron Reynoso, Dirtee Disco, Muslija and Womack. The event was billed as a long-form house-focused beach-club session.

events.title: Alan Dixon at Bonbonniere Tulum
events.summary: Bonbonniere Tulum presented Alan Dixon with XANDRO on February 20. The RA listing classified the event under house and funk/soul.

events.title: PPP presents Music Journey by M.A.N.D.Y
events.summary: Papaya Playa Project's Saturday Celebration listed M.A.N.D.Y. for a beachfront Music Journey on February 21. Resident Advisor also listed Jo.Ke and DJ Freshh on the lineup for this date.

events.title: Peces Raros DJ Set - Arena Lunar x Lostnights
events.summary: Arena Lunar and Lostnights presented an electronic night led by Peces Raros DJ Set at Arena Tulum. The published program listed WEBETTERFLYTOMARS!, Julito and Peces Raros across the evening.

events.title: AIRRICA x Bonbonniere Tulum
events.summary: Bonbonniere Tulum booked AIRRICA with XANDRO for a late-night February 26 event. The event was listed by the venue's promoter Sun and Flower Agency.

events.title: Nômade Presents Origins: Juicifer
events.summary: Nômade Tulum's Origins night featured Jose Noventa, also known as Juicifer. The listing described his sound as blending house, deep house, downtempo and world music influences.

events.title: Sinner 5th Anniversary
events.summary: Sinner marked its fifth anniversary at Vagalume with Raxon B2B Shall Ocin, VITE + Miganova, SIB and RENÊ. The party is a recurring boutique electronic series created by VITE and Miganova.
